description: This file defines data structures and classes related to 'Airties Ethernet Interface' TLV (Type-Length-Value) for a network device configuration or communication protocol. It includes class definitions, nested structures, and references external headers, serving as a schema or specification for parsing or generating such TLVs.

classes.name: tlvAirtiesEthernetInterface
classes.description: Class representing Airties Ethernet Interface TLV with properties such as vendor type, length, vendor OUI, TLV ID, physical interface list.

classes.name: cInterfaceList
classes.description: Class representing a list of Ethernet interfaces, containing properties like port ID, MAC address, interface name, and flags.

classes.name: sFlags1
classes.description: Struct representing flags related to Ethernet port state, including admin state, link state, duplex mode, and reserved bits.

classes.name: sFlags2
classes.description: Struct representing link type support and current link type bits.
